``` { .yaml linenums="1" }
services:

  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:6.9.1
    ports:
      - 8180:80
      - 8443:443
    hostname: mydomain.com
    deploy:
       mode: replicated
       replicas: 1
       restart_policy:
         condition: on-failure
         delay: 5s
         max_attempts: 3
         window: 120s
    environment:
      TZ: America/Los_Angeles
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db:3306
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: <username>
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/wordpress_db_password_v2
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: wordpressdb
      WORDPRESS_HOSTNAME: mydomain.com
      WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA: |
        /* Multisite */
        define('WP_ALLOW_MULTISITE', true );
        define( 'MULTISITE', true );
        define( 'SUBDOMAIN_INSTALL', true );
        define( 'DOMAIN_CURRENT_SITE', 'mydomain.com' ); 
        define( 'PATH_CURRENT_SITE', '/' );
        define( 'SITE_ID_CURRENT_SITE', 1 );
        define( 'BLOG_ID_CURRENT_SITE', 1 );

    volumes:
      - html:/var/www/html
    extra_hosts:
     - mydomain.com:203.0.113.10
    secrets:
      - wordpress_db_password_v2

  db:
    image: mysql:8.0@sha256:968e12b1fde035655c7a940db808b47372b70128293a38a3914e0b291c306e5e
    environment:
      TZ: America/Los_Angeles
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/wordpress_mysql_root_password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: wordpressdb
      MYSQL_USER: <username>
      MYSQL_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/wordpress_db_password_v2
    deploy:
       mode: replicated
       replicas: 1
       restart_policy:
         condition: on-failure
         delay: 5s
         max_attempts: 3
         window: 120s
    volumes:
      - db:/var/lib/mysql
    secrets:
      - wordpress_mysql_root_password
      - wordpress_db_password_v2

secrets:
  wordpress_db_password_v2:
    external: true
  wordpress_mysql_root_password:
    external: true

configs:
  wpadmin_conf:
    file: ./wpadmin.conf
    name: wpadmin_conf_v2

volumes:
  html:
    driver: local
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      device: "/mnt/docker-cephFS/wordpress_html"
      o: bind
  db:
    driver: local
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      device: "/mnt/docker-cephFS/wordpress_db"
      o: bind
```
